# Upstream's two forms differ. docker run: the host path /vw-data/ and --publish 127.0.0.1:8000:80. The compose file: ./vw-data/, which import
# makes a managed volume named vaultwarden-vw-data. This line says what the compose file says.
--name vaultwarden --restart unless-stopped
-e DOMAIN=https://vw.domain.tld
-v vaultwarden-vw-data:/data/
-p 127.0.0.1:8000:80
vaultwarden/server:latest
